placements.role: Mines and processes tungsten ore concentrate at the Sangdong mine in South Korea, the single largest new non-China tungsten supply source, ramping since June 2026.

evidence.claim: Almonty Industries began feeding stockpiled run-of-mine ore through its newly commissioned Sangdong processing plant during June 2026, transitioning the mine to saleable tungsten concentrate production; Sangdong is expected to supply over 80% of global non-China tungsten production once it reaches full capacity.
evidence.source_name: Almonty Industries, Almonty Commences Processing Operations at Sangdong Mine
evidence.source_excerpt: During June 2026, the Company began feeding stockpiled run-of-mine ore through its newly commissioned processing plant; is expected to supply over 80% of global non-China tungsten production upon reaching full capacity

placements.role: Explores and is advancing pre-production US tungsten deposits (Pilot Mountain and Tempiute, Nevada) that would add to the thin non-China feedstock base.

evidence.claim: Guardian Metal Resources is advancing the Pilot Mountain tungsten project in Nevada (positive Pre-Feasibility Study results announced June 2026, targeting initial production in late 2028) and holds the Tempiute project, previously one of the largest producing tungsten mines in the US, both pre-production.
evidence.source_name: Guardian Metal Resources PLC, company website (project pages)
evidence.source_excerpt: Positive Pre-Feasibility Study results announced in June 2026, confirming Pilot; Previously one of the largest producing tungsten mines in the U.S.

placements.role: Operates a commercial-scale lithium-ion battery recycling and black-mass refining facility in Nevada; black mass sales are the majority of company revenue.

evidence.claim: Sales of black mass represent the majority of American Battery Technology Company's total revenue, and substantially all of its current black mass customers are located outside the United States in OECD countries; the company operates a commercial-scale battery recycling facility. On July 30, 2026, President Trump issued a Presidential Determination declaring black mass a critical material essential to national security.

evidence.source_excerpt: Sales of black mass represents the majority of the company's total revenue; substantially all of its current black mass customers are located outside the United States in OECD countries

placements.role: Developing AquaRefining, a proprietary hydrometallurgical/electrochemical process to refine black mass into battery metals domestically; over 4,000 pilot hours demonstrated.

evidence.claim: Aqua Metals remains pre-revenue on its core AquaRefining recycling technology: over 4,000 hours of pilot runtime is demonstrated, with commercial deployment of the hydrometallurgical process targeted for 2026 and beyond.
evidence.source_name: Investing.com, Aqua Metals 2026 presentation: battery recycling tech targets China cost parity
evidence.source_excerpt: The technology has demonstrated over 4,000 hours of runtime, full-scale commercial validation remains pending; commercial deployment of its AquaRefining technology in 2026 and beyond

placements.role: Maintains an internal tungsten scrap-recycling capability that reclaims tungsten carbide scrap back into its own carbide production, a working domestic tungsten-side recycling and refining capacity.

evidence.claim: Kennametal's core expertise includes tungsten carbides, ceramics and super-hard materials used in metal cutting and extreme wear applications, and the company maintains an internal tungsten recycling capability that reclaims scrap tungsten carbide, reducing reliance on third-party and imported tungsten sources.
evidence.source_name: Kennametal Inc, Form 10-K FY2026 (period ended 2026-06-30), Business section
evidence.source_excerpt: The Company's core expertise includes the development and application of tungsten carbides, ceramics, super-hard materials and solutions used in metal cutting and extreme wear applications. Additionally, our internal tungsten recycling capability provides us access to additional sources of tungsten, and therefore, helps to mitigate our reliance on third parties.
